description: Use when you need the native coin balance (ETH or POL) of an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: wei and a decimal amount from a public node, with the block number and as_of. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/native-balance, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Native coin on one chain only; for stablecoins or several chains use wallet_balance. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

address.description: Account whose native coin balance is read (0x + 40 hex)

chain.description: Chain to read; the coin is ETH, or POL on polygon; default base
